question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Gloomy
solution:
The correct answer is '**Depressing**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Gloomy**' is '**Depressing**'.
 
• **Gloomy**: dark in way that makes you feel sad. (ऐसा गहरा कि उदास कर दे)
 
 
• *Example: This dark paint makes the room very **gloomy**.*
 
 
 
• **Depressing**: causing or resulting in a feeling of miserable dejection. (उदास करने वाला, विषादकारी, निराशाजनक)
 
 
• *Example: The thought of growing old alone is very **depressing**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Depressing.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Comfortable**: that makes you feel physically relaxed and in no pain; that provides you with everything your body needs. (आरामदेह, सुखद)
 
• **Bright**: having a lot of light. (प्रकाश-भरा, प्रदीप्‍त, उज्ज्वल, चमकीला)
 
• **Intrepid**: without any fear of danger. (संकट के भय से रहित; निर्भीक)
